scientific_integrity: All-parameter result proved by exact support-function case analysis; finite exact computations corroborate only dimensions 3 through 7. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns unweighted book-graph metric free spaces; cubical describes combinatorial face type, not Euclidean congruence. Full prior-art equivalence cannot be ruled out from indexed literature; the known total facet count is excluded from novelty.
title: Cubical norming faces and a complete face polynomial for book-graph Lipschitz-free spaces
